{
  "summary": "Today is quiet with no scheduled events, but tomorrow has a calendar conflict between soccer and family dinner. Additionally, a school permission slip for [[P_KID4]] is due tomorrow.",
  "briefing_md": "# Morning Briefing\n\n### ⚠️ Urgent Deadlines\n* **Permission Slip Due Tomorrow:** [[P_KID4]] needs a signed permission slip for this Friday's science center field trip. It is due back tomorrow, **Monday, August 31st** (noted as Sep 1st in the school mail). Don't forget that a sack lunch will also be required for the trip.\n\n### 📅 Calendar Conflict Tomorrow\n* **Soccer vs. Dinner:** Tomorrow, [[P_KID1]] has soccer practice from **17:00 - 18:30** (cleats needed), which overlaps with Family dinner at [[P_GRANDMA]]'s scheduled for **17:30 - 19:00**.\n* *Suggested Fix:* We have drafted a message to [[P_GRANDMA]] to propose shifting dinner back to 19:00 to accommodate soccer.",
  "actions": [
    {
      "action_type": "calendar_create_event",
      "entity": "calendar.hearthbeat_family",
      "when": "now",
      "why": "There is a calendar conflict between [[P_KID1]]'s soccer practice and family dinner at [[P_GRANDMA]]'s on Monday, August 31.",
      "sensitive": false,
      "title": "[hearthbeat] Conflict: [[P_KID1]] Soccer vs Dinner at [[P_GRANDMA]]'s",
      "start_iso": "2026-08-31T17:30:00",
      "end_iso": "2026-08-31T18:30:00",
      "message": ""
    },
    {
      "action_type": "notify_family_member",
      "entity": "[[P_GRANDMA]]",
      "when": "now",
      "why": "Family dinner at [[P_GRANDMA]]'s overlaps with [[P_KID1]]'s soccer practice on Monday, so we need to propose an adjustment.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "title": "",
      "start_iso": "",
      "end_iso": "",
      "message": "Hi [[P_GRANDMA]], we have a conflict tomorrow with [[P_KID1]]'s soccer practice (17:00-18:30) and dinner (17:30-19:00). Would it be okay if we adjusted dinner to start at 19:00 instead?"
    },
    {
      "action_type": "send_briefing",
      "entity": "[[P_DAD]]",
      "when": "now",
      "why": "To provide [[P_DAD]] with a morning briefing highlighting the urgent school deadline and calendar conflict.",
      "sensitive": false,
      "title": "",
      "start_iso": "",
      "end_iso": "",
      "message": "Good morning [[P_DAD]]. Please note that [[P_KID4]]'s signed permission slip for Friday's science center field trip is due tomorrow, Monday. Additionally, there is a calendar conflict tomorrow between [[P_KID1]]'s soccer practice and family dinner at [[P_GRANDMA]]'s."
    }
  ]
}
